description: Bake muffins and cupcakes to your heart's content with no worry about a sticky mess. ProBake Nonstick 12-Cup Muffin Pan features a Teflon Xtra coating that's designed for high performance making this pan ideal for every day wear and tear. No need for paper cup liners. This nonstick coating also offers superior food release leaving no sticky residue, so cleanup is always quick and easy. ProBake pans are made with professional weight steel construction to ensure even heating delivering golden brown baking results every time. The ProBake collection is proudly made in the USA, made without PFOA, and backed by a 10-year limited . Hand wash and towel dry only. External dimensions are 13. 8-inch bx 10. 4-inch x 1. 2-inch. Cup measures 2. 9-inch in diameter.
